title: The mutant driver runs an unmutated copy first and counts no kills unless it is green
why: Lane fix-check-render-first (#2392), 23:34 CST Nov 8: a mutant tree lacked actions/ci-alarm/events.json, so merge failed at import and every chain case was red on every mutant; the earlier kills proved nothing.
note: hooks/mutate_guard.py: run the unmutated tree first; if it is not green, report unknown and count no kills. Red case first: a mutant tree with a file missing.
